Aggregate a Voxel-Level MEDuSA Trial Panel to Parcels / ROIs

Source: R/poet_covreg.R
aggregate_decon_panel.Rd

Collapses a voxel-level decon_epoch_regression output (or stacked trial-by-voxel data.table) into a parcel-level panel while propagating shared cross-voxel and cross-parcel measurement-error vectors (shared_noise_vec), cross-trial correlations (trial_cor_vec), cross-lag embeddings (lag_noise_vec), exact parcel se_demixed, Empirical-Bayes tau2_bio / precision_weight, and any attached shared_error_model for downstream decon_connectivity_repair or mixed_by analyses.

Usage

aggregate_decon_panel(
  x,
  parcel_groups,
  parcel_weights = c("auto", "equal", "supplied"),
  weights = NULL,
  voxel_col = "voxel",
  parcel_col = "parcel",
  id_col = "id",
  run_col = "run",
  trial_col = "trial",
  lag_col = "evt_time"
)

Arguments

x

A voxel-level decon_epoch_regression result list, a trial-level data.frame/data.table (including CSV/Parquet panels read via data.table::fread or medusa_read_table), a character file path (or vector of paths), or a list of per-subject results.

parcel_groups

Either a named character/factor vector mapping voxel IDs to parcel labels, an unnamed vector matching voxel_ids order, or a data.frame containing voxel and parcel mapping columns.

parcel_weights

Weighting rule within each parcel: "auto" (inverse squared se_demixed with 10% median floor), "equal", or "supplied".

weights

Optional named numeric vector of voxel weights when parcel_weights = "supplied".

voxel_col

Name of the voxel column in the input panel (default "voxel").

parcel_col

Name of the output parcel column (default "parcel").

id_col, run_col, trial_col, lag_col

Subject, run, trial, and lag column names.

Value

If x is a decon_epoch_regression result list, an updated parcel-level result list with panel, parcel_weights, unit_error_cor, and shared_error_model. If x is a data.frame/data.table, a parcel-aggregated data.table.

Details

When parcel assignments are fixed prior to Stage 3, passing parcel_groups directly to decon_epoch_regression (aggregate_by_parcel = TRUE) is fastest because Stage-3 de-mixing and exact \(P \times P\) POET covariance regression run once on the parcel series. Use aggregate_decon_panel() when you have already fit a voxelwise panel (aggregate_by_parcel = FALSE, including whole-brain lowrank_voxel panels or saved RDS/Parquet/CSV tables) and want to collapse voxels into one or more parcellations post-hoc without re-running deconvolution: intra-parcel voxel error correlations are propagated via the vector norms \(\|\sum_{v \in g} w_v \mathbf{s}_{v,i}\|_2\) of shared_noise_vec (or the attached shared_error_model) so parcel se_demixed and inter-parcel error covariances remain calibrated for decon_connectivity_repair and mixed_by.

See also

decon_epoch_regression, decon_connectivity_repair, mixed_by
